title: SEC1: crypto2dev_cipher exceeds 150-line limit
description:
crypto2dev_cipher() spans lines 633-832 (approximately 200 lines), well over the project's 150-line guideline.

The function contains two separate switch statements over info->cipher.type:
1. Lines 649-682: extract aes pointer, algo string, iv pointer
2. Lines 755-783: extract in_buf, out_buf, data_sz

This duplication means adding a new cipher mode (e.g., AES-XTS or DES3) requires updating two separate switch blocks, with no compiler enforcement that both stay in sync.

Fix: extract a helper struct or inline helper that maps cipher type to (aes, algo, iv, ivSz, in, out, sz) in one place, then use it for both initialization and I/O. This eliminates the duplicated switch and reduces the function below 150 lines.

Affected lines: crypto2dev_port.c:633-832.
